column1: # The real people of January 2029: who the game seats before any fictional newcomer can appear (2030 on; see
# people.Newcomers and tuning.properties people.newcomers.*). From public records as of 2025-26 (the 119th Congress
# and its committee leaders; the Trump and Biden administrations' officials as cabinet prospects; federal appellate
# judges as Supreme Court prospects). 'until' is the last year in office of someone known to be leaving before 2029:
# their seat goes to an office-labelled placeholder, never an invented name. Tab-separated; kinds:
#   senator  state  class  party  name  until
#   chair    H|S  committee  party  name  until       (the committee's leader for that party: chair or ranking member)
#   swing    H|S  party  state  name  until           (moderates the whip counts on)
#   base     H|S  party  state  name                  (stalwarts of each party's base, for the whip's base member)
#   crossover  party  name  background               (the other party's moderates out of office, for a bipartisan pick)
#   cabinet  post  party  name  background            (prospects for each post, WestWingData.POST_NAME)
#   judge    party  name  born                        (prospects for the Supreme Court)
#   staff    role  party  name  background             (White House staff prospects, WestWingData.STAFF_TITLE)
